title: Hayati Pro Max Mango Peach Pineapple Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Mango Peach Pineapple brings together three tropical favourites in a sunny, fruit-forward blend. Ripe Mango delivers soft, tropical sweetness, Peach adds a mellow, juicy lift, and Pineapple cuts through with a bright tang that balances the mix with just enough sharpness. The result is a smooth yet punchy fruit medley that captures the warmth and vibrancy of tropical fruit. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid ensures fast-acting nicotine absorption, and a more comfortable throat hit, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with starter kits and pod systems. Its 50VG/50PG ratio provides well-rounded flavour and consistent vapour production. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
